==Overview==
* Imperial treasury during this season announced by the Civil Service at 1433 thrones and 4 crowns.
* The following has been donated to the Imperial treasury: None.

==Administrative==
This administrative motion was raised as the first order of business at the first Senate session on Friday.
* [[Amend powers of the Advisor on the Vallorn]] to include [[New_Imperial_titles#Custodian|Custodianship]] of the [[Advisor_on_the_Vallorn#The_Great_Library_of_Hacynian|Great Library of Hacynian]] - first order of business, Friday
* [[Create Senate power of relinquishment II|Create Senate power of relinquishment]] - Sunday session, Constitutional vote

A total of 11 [[commission|commissions]] were announced during the Winter Solstice: 8 standard commissions, 2 wayleaves, and 1 under the auspices of [[Those_who_worship#Almodin_Okt.C3.ADstis.2C_Priest_of_the_Builder|Almodin Oktístis]].
